استمعوا (form VIII)
# اِسْتَمَعُوا (istamaʕū) /is.ta.ma.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# اُسْتُمِعُوا (ustumiʕū) /us.tu.mi.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# اِسْتَمِعُوا (istamiʕū) /is.ta.mi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
